en_title: GTA 6 Was Originally Meant to Release Much Sooner Than We Realized
subtitle: 全员投入西部
opus_summary: Rockstar原计划同步开发《GTA6》与《荒野大镖客：救赎2》，后因后者需要全员投入而暂缓前者。彭博社称，《GTA6》的故事框架直到2019年底才成形。

paragraphs.en: Rockstar Games has revealed that it originally intended to develop GTA 6 alongside Red Dead Redemption 2, meaning it probably would've come out much sooner than we ever realized.
paragraphs.cn: Rockstar透露，公司原本打算同时开发《GTA6》和《荒野大镖客：救赎2》。若按原计划推进，《GTA6》可能会比我们想象中早得多地发售。

paragraphs.en: As told in a new article from Bloomberg , Rockstar Games initially planned to develop Red Dead 2 and GTA 6 at the same time, but that quickly became infeasible. Rockstar North co-studio head Rob Nelson recognized that the ambition behind Red Dead Redemption 2 meant they would need to treat it as an all-hands-on-deck situation, which also meant putting GTA 6 on the back burner. However, GTA 6 would benefit from this, as Nelson noted to Bloomberg that everything they built for Red Dead would "pay off" in GTA 6.
paragraphs.cn: 据彭博社最新报道，Rockstar最初计划同时开发《荒野大镖客：救赎2》和《GTA6》，但很快就发现这条路走不通。Rockstar North联席负责人Rob Nelson意识到，要实现《荒野大镖客：救赎2》的雄心，就需要全员投入，《GTA6》也因此只能暂时搁置。不过，《GTA6》也会从中受益。Nelson向彭博社表示，团队为《荒野大镖客：救赎》打造的一切，都会在《GTA6》中「得到回报」。

paragraphs.en: That appears to be true, as GTA 6 uses a lot of ideas and systems from Red Dead Redemption 2, including its NPC interaction system. It seems unlikely that GTA 6 would be what it is today if it had stayed the course and been developed in tandem with the western sequel. Unfortunately for fans, it means the game took much longer to make. Had it been developed simultaneously, it seems likely that Rockstar would've been able to release GTA 6 in the early 2020s.
paragraphs.cn: 这番话似乎确实如此：《GTA6》采用了《荒野大镖客：救赎2》的许多理念和系统，包括NPC互动系统。如果团队坚持原计划，与这部西部题材续作同步开发，《GTA6》似乎不太可能成为如今的样子。但对玩家而言，遗憾的是，这也让游戏的开发耗时长了许多。如果两款游戏同步开发，Rockstar似乎很可能在2020年代初就能推出《GTA6》。

paragraphs.en: Of course, the first release window that Rockstar ever actually publicly provided for GTA 6 was 2025. The game was delayed a couple of times, much to the bewilderment of Strauss Zelnick, the CEO of Rockstar's parent company, Take-Two Interactive. Rockstar's head of publishing Jennifer Kolbe noted that she had to call Zelnick just months after announcing the game's first delay to inform him that they would need more time.
paragraphs.cn: 当然，Rockstar首次正式对外公布的《GTA6》发售窗口是2025年。游戏此后两度延期，让Rockstar母公司Take-Two Interactive的首席执行官Strauss Zelnick大感错愕。Rockstar发行负责人Jennifer Kolbe表示，首次宣布延期后仅仅几个月，她就不得不给Zelnick打电话，告诉他团队还需要更多时间。

paragraphs.en: “I think he said, ‘You’re kidding. Please tell me you’re kidding,’” recalled Kolbe to Bloomberg. “But once we talked through why, he got it. And I think we are really lucky that he is as reasonable as he is, because a lot of people would say, ‘You’d just better figure out how to ship it.’ And we have been really, really lucky that we have not found ourselves in that place, because that happens to a lot of teams, and we’ve all played those games. It’s not great.”
paragraphs.cn: Kolbe向彭博社回忆道：「我记得他说的是，你在开玩笑吧。拜托，告诉我你是在开玩笑。但等我们把原因解释清楚，他就理解了。我觉得我们真的很幸运，他这么通情达理，因为很多人会要求你，无论如何都得想办法把游戏做出来发售。我们没有陷入那种处境，真的非常、非常幸运，因为很多团队都遇到过这种情况，我们也都玩过那些游戏。体验并不好。」

paragraphs.en: Bloomberg's report dispels rumors that GTA 6 has been in active development since shortly after GTA 5 was released in 2013, but that doesn't mean Rockstar only began working on it after Red Dead 2's launch. Various teams and leadership within Rockstar have been researching and planning GTA 6 since as early as 2014. Rockstar has spoken at length in recent interviews about taking staff to Florida to research and dream up ideas for GTA 6 during the mid to late 2010s.
paragraphs.cn: 此前有传言称，《GTA5》于2013年发售后不久，《GTA6》就已进入正式开发阶段，彭博社的报道澄清了这一说法。但这并不代表Rockstar直到《荒野大镖客：救赎2》发售后才开始着手制作。早在2014年，Rockstar内部的多个团队和管理层就已开始为《GTA6》调研和规划。在近期的采访中，Rockstar详细谈到了团队在2010年代中后期带员工前往佛罗里达州，为《GTA6》实地调研、构思创意的经历。

paragraphs.en: Bloomberg noted that the team didn't have a "skeleton" for GTA 6's story until the end of 2019, a year after Red Dead 2's release. Even then, it took a while before the team was able to fully wrap its head around what the game would be. Rockstar has vowed to not take nearly as long on its next game , thanks to the fact it seems to have fewer obstacles going forward.
paragraphs.cn: 彭博社指出，直到2019年底，也就是《荒野大镖客：救赎2》发售一年后，团队才搭建起《GTA6》的故事「框架」。即便如此，团队又花了一段时间，才完全想清楚这款游戏究竟要做成什么样。由于今后面临的障碍似乎会更少，Rockstar承诺，下一款游戏的开发时间将远短于这次。

paragraphs.en: Rockstar doubled in size during GTA 6's development, encountered multiple leaks, had a loss in productivity during the pandemic, and much more. The studio also made major changes to how it operates and expects that will set it up for success moving forward. What is Rockstar's next game? We don't know. Some may expect Red Dead 3, but other fans are hoping that Rockstar will break the cycle of alternating between Red Dead and GTA in favor of something new or reviving a different IP. Whatever the case is, don't expect it to take another eight years.
paragraphs.cn: 在《GTA6》开发期间，Rockstar规模扩大了一倍，遭遇过多次泄露，疫情期间生产效率也有所下降，此外还有诸多状况。工作室还大幅调整了运作方式，并希望这些改变能为今后的成功打下基础。Rockstar的下一款游戏会是什么？我们还不知道。有些人或许期待《荒野大镖客：救赎3》，但另一些玩家则希望Rockstar打破《荒野大镖客：救赎》与《GTA》交替推出的循环，转而制作新作，或重启其他IP。不管是哪种情况，别以为这次还要再等八年。
